QuestifyCoreTests/ClubActionServiceTests.reason: Reviewed intentional request-format change in the public iOS tests. The previous method required multipart only for leave; the replacement requires JSON for join, apply and leave while retaining the receipt, authorization, numeric ID, application-message restrictions and exactly one send. Its bound companion tests reject invalid IDs, precision loss, retries and multipart fallback. This is a contract replacement, not byte-equivalent behavior.

QuestifyCoreTests/MerchantContentContrac.reason: Reviewed scoped-validation change in the public iOS tests. The old method rejected the city fixture row ID unconditionally. The replacement accepts that ID only in the city snapshot and explicitly rejects the same row in another query and a conflicting explicit POI ID. The old universal-rejection expectation is intentionally superseded; no general ID aliasing is approved.

QuestifyCoreTests/MerchantContentService.reason: Reviewed request-expectation change in the public iOS fake-transport test. The project-list assertion still requires merchant scope. The workspace assertion now checks an exact body containing the requested topic ID and merchant scope instead of topic ID alone. The test exercises the existing access fixture and request construction; it does not establish new authorization or live-service behavior.

QuestifyCoreTests/MerchantTemplateAssist.reason: Reviewed local acceptance-flow change in the public iOS tests. Whole-result apply is replaced by explicit per-field acceptance. Generation still leaves the draft unchanged and performs zero saves; accepting one field cannot change its sibling. The current test also checks the accepted answer, absence of confirmation, zero saves and rejection of repeated acceptance. This is an intentional finer-grained contract replacement.

QuestifyCoreTests/ShopNPCTests/testEmpty.reason: Reviewed stricter decoding expectation in the public iOS tests. The old method accepted legacy text when safeText was empty. The replacement requires decoding to throw for empty safeText even when the fixture carries otherwise successful result fields and a nonempty legacy text value. This intentionally removes the fallback rather than renaming equivalent coverage.
